mapper.insert: INSERT INTO conversation (item_id, buyer_id, seller_id, last_message_at) VALUES (#{itemId}, #{buyerId}, #{sellerId}, #{lastMessageAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, item_id, buyer_id, seller_id, last_message_at, created_at FROM conversation WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, item_id, buyer_id, seller_id, last_message_at, created_at FROM conversation WHERE item_id = #{itemId} AND buyer_id = #{buyerId} LIMIT 1

SELECT c.id, c.item_id, i.title AS item_title, (SELECT img.url FROM item_image img WHERE img.item_id = i.id ORDER BY img.sort_no, img.id LIMIT 1) AS item_cover_url, i.price AS item_price, CASE WHEN c.buyer_id = #{userId} THEN c.seller_id ELSE c.buyer_id END AS other_user_id, CASE WHEN c.buyer_id = #{userId} THEN su.nickname ELSE bu.nickname END AS other_nickname, CASE WHEN c.buyer_id = #{userId} THEN su.avatar_url ELSE bu.avatar_url END AS other_avatar_url, CASE WHEN c.buyer_id = #{userId} THEN su.auth_status ELSE bu.auth_status END AS other_auth_status, (SELECT m.content FROM message m WHERE m.conversation_id = c.id ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_message, c.last_message_at, c.created_at FROM conversation c JOIN item i ON i.id = c.item_id JOIN sys_user bu ON bu.id = c.buyer_id JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = c.seller_id WHERE c.buyer_id = #{userId} OR c.seller_id = #{userId} ORDER BY COALESCE(c.last_message_at, c.created_at) DESC, c.id DESC

SELECT c.id, c.item_id, i.title AS item_title, (SELECT img.url FROM item_image img WHERE img.item_id = i.id ORDER BY img.sort_no, img.id LIMIT 1) AS item_cover_url, i.price AS item_price, CASE WHEN c.buyer_id = #{userId} THEN c.seller_id ELSE c.buyer_id END AS other_user_id, CASE WHEN c.buyer_id = #{userId} THEN su.nickname ELSE bu.nickname END AS other_nickname, CASE WHEN c.buyer_id = #{userId} THEN su.avatar_url ELSE bu.avatar_url END AS other_avatar_url, CASE WHEN c.buyer_id = #{userId} THEN su.auth_status ELSE bu.auth_status END AS other_auth_status, (SELECT m.content FROM message m WHERE m.conversation_id = c.id ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_message, c.last_message_at, c.created_at FROM conversation c JOIN item i ON i.id = c.item_id JOIN sys_user bu ON bu.id = c.buyer_id JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = c.seller_id WHERE c.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE conversation SET last_message_at = #{lastMessageAt} WHERE id = #{id}
